subject: maths
question: A alone can do a piece of work in 7 days, while B alone can do it in 10 days. In how many days will they complete the same work if they both work together?
solution:
Given:

A alone can do a piece of work in 7 days, while B alone can do it in 10 days.

Concept used:

If A and B alone can complete a task in X and Y days respectively, then they together will take = XY/(X + Y) days to complete the work.
